name: Falcon Dagger
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Weight 1 lb.; Slot weapon; Price 6,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

These jagged-bladed +1 daggers are decorated with copper feathers and can, once per day, give their wielder the ability to fly, as the spell, for three rounds, consecutively. Activating the flight power is a swift action

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells fly, Quicken Spell; Cost 3,000 gp
